modern: Nature, which governs the whole, will soon change all the things you see, and out of their substance will make other things, and again other things from the substance of those, so that the world may be always new.
original: Nature which governs the whole will soon change all things thou seest, and out of their substance will make other things, and again other things from the substance of them, in order that the world may be ever new.
